instructions: Read every complete case in the paired workbook. The default is only a draft. Put a full Decision object in Override for every contradiction, then sign reviewedAllCases. The compiler refuses unsigned or candidate-less rows.

rows.Kwic: 依弘景律師出家通天二年受戒後習毘尼藏

Override.AttributionNote: 古尊宿語錄, Nanyue Huairang biography. Nanyue Huairang is the exact grammatical actor: the biographical sentence says that at fifteen he left his parents and went to Yuquan Monastery, where he entered monastic life under Vinaya Master Hongjing; Hongjing is the named preceptor, not the narrator or subject.

rows.Kwic: 中著一點後有僧舉似忠國師國師云欽師猶被馬師惑。問和尚為甚麼說即心即佛師曰為止小兒啼曰啼止時如何師曰非心非佛曰除此二種人來如何指示師曰向伊道不是物曰忽遇其中

Override.AttributionNote: 古尊宿語錄, Mazu Daoyi section. Mazu Daoyi is the exact speaker: after a monk asks what Mazu says when the child's crying has stopped, Mazu answers 'not mind, not Buddha.'

rows.Kwic: 師曰我鼻孔被大師𢬟得痛不徹

Override.AttributionNote: 古尊宿語錄, Baizhang Huaihai biography. Baizhang Huaihai is the exact speaker: after returning in tears from attending Mazu Daoyi, he tells a fellow attendant that the great master twisted his nostrils painfully.

rows.Kwic: 溈山云馬祖出八十四人善知識幾人得大機幾人得大用仰山云百丈得大機黃檗得大用

Override.AttributionNote: 古尊宿語錄, a Guishan Lingyou-Yangshan Huiji exchange preserved in Baizhang Huaihai's record. Yangshan Huiji is the exact principal headword-bearing speaker: he first calls the raised-whisk encounter a display of great capacity and great function and then says Huangbo Xiyun obtained great function; Guishan's intervening question repeats the term.

rows.Kwic: 不昧囙果老人於言下大悟告辝師云某甲已免野狐身

ActorAttribution.ActorLabel: the unnamed old man freed from the wild-fox body

Override.AttributionNote: 古尊宿語錄, Baizhang Huaihai's wild-fox case. The exact actor is the unnamed old man freed from the wild-fox body: after Baizhang answers 'not obscuring cause and effect,' the old man says that he has escaped that body. The complete case and all six ladder rungs preserve his former office but no personal name.

rows.Kwic: 沈空滯寂及自知名無學聲聞

Override.AttributionNote: 古尊宿語錄, Baizhang Huaihai's second recorded discourse. Baizhang Huaihai is the exact speaker throughout the extended teaching turn, including his statement that sinking into emptiness, stagnating in quiescence, and knowing this oneself is called an adept beyond training.

rows.Kwic: 但消融表裏情盡都無依執是無事人

Override.AttributionNote: 古尊宿語錄, Huangbo Xiyun section. Huangbo Xiyun is the exact speaker: in a continuous teaching turn he says that when inner and outer feelings are dissolved and no reliance remains, this is an unconcerned person.

rows.Kwic: 問德山棒臨濟喝未審明得什麼邊事師云你試道看僧便喝

Override.AttributionNote: 古尊宿語錄, public exchange in Shoushan Xingnian's record. The exact speaker is an unnamed questioning monk: he asks what side of the matter Deshan's stick and Linji's shout clarify; Shoushan tells him to try speaking. The complete interview and all six ladder rungs do not name the monk.

rows.Kwic: 上堂舉世尊以青蓮目顧視大眾迦葉正當與麼時且道說箇什麼若道不說而說又是埋沒先聖且道說箇什麼師乃拂袖而退󲈺擲下拄杖便歸方丈侍者隨後入室請益念法華為什麼不祗對和尚󲈺云念法華會也次日師與真園頭同上問訊次󲈺又問真曰作麼生是世尊不說說真曰鵓鳩樹頭鳴󲈺云你作

Override.AttributionNote: 古尊宿語錄, Shoushan Xingnian biography recounting his testing under Fengxue Yanzhao. Fengxue Yanzhao is the exact actor: after Shoushan withdraws from Fengxue's hall address, the text explicitly says that Fengxue threw down his staff and returned to the abbot's quarters.

古尊宿語錄, Shimen Yuncong's recorded sayings. Shimen Yuncong is the exact speaker: the level-one section names Chan Master Cizhao Yuncong, and his uninterrupted hall address closes, 'open your mouth and it is already distant; deliberate and it is already wrong.'

rows.Kwic: 若是宗師湏以本分事接人始得

Override.AttributionNote: 古尊宿語錄, Zihu Lizong's hall address raising his visit to Guishan Lingyou. Guishan Lingyou is the exact quoted speaker: after being asked the ancestral teacher's meaning, Guishan asks for his stool and says that a lineage master must meet people with the fundamental matter.

rows.Kwic: 舉古云聞聲悟道見色明心師云作麼生是聞聲悟道見色明心

Override.AttributionNote: 古尊宿語錄, Yunmen Wenyan's Essential Sayings from the Master's Room. Yunmen Wenyan is the exact speaker: after raising the old wording 'awaken to the Way on hearing sound; clarify mind on seeing form,' he directly asks what that wording means.
古尊宿語錄, Yunmen Wenyan's Essential Sayings from the Master's Room. Yunmen Wenyan is the exact speaker: in his own instruction he says to wait until the other person deliberates and then strike.

rows.Kwic: 上堂舉龐居士問馬大師不與萬法為侶是甚麼人大師云待汝一口吸盡西江水即向汝道師云大小祖師只知開口易不覺舌頭長當時若問育王但云若要向汝道直待虛空落地自然出他一頭

Override.AttributionNote: 古尊宿語錄, Wuchu Daguan's hall address raising Pang Yun's exchange with Mazu Daoyi. Mazu Daoyi is the exact quoted speaker of the headword-bearing answer: he tells Pang Yun that he will answer when Pang swallows the West River in one gulp.

rows.Kwic: 真人是什麼乾屎橛便歸方丈

Override.AttributionNote: 古尊宿語錄, Guangzhi Quanwu's hall address raising Linji Yixuan's person-of-no-rank exchange. Linji Yixuan is the exact quoted speaker: after the monk deliberates, Linji pushes him away and asks what the person of no rank is—a dry shit-stick.

rows.Kwic: 汝今於三業門中稟受戒法所謂不殺不盜不妄

Override.AttributionNote: 古尊宿語錄, Foyan Qingyuan's second recorded sayings. Foyan Qingyuan is the exact speaker: in his address to his staff as a disciple he says that it receives the precept teaching through the three karmic faculties and enumerates the five precepts.

rows.Kwic: 汝今於三業門中稟受戒法所謂不殺不盜不妄

Override.AttributionNote: 古尊宿語錄, Foyan Qingyuan's second recorded sayings. Foyan Qingyuan is the exact speaker: in his address to his staff as a disciple he says, 'within the three karmic faculties, receive the precept teaching,' and then enumerates the five precepts.

rows.Kwic: 閙中得靜則井邑成山林煩惱即菩提眾生成正覺此語初心學人例道得會得作一種平等知見

Override.AttributionNote: 古尊宿語錄, Foyan Qingyuan's Essential Instruction for Chan Practitioners. Foyan Qingyuan is the exact author and speaker: within that explicitly headed instruction he presents 'afflictions are awakening' among statements that beginners commonly claim to understand, then tests that claimed understanding.

rows.Kwic: 有年有德復云不用愛聖聖是空名不用厭凢凢是妄立若得聖凢情盡喚作體露真常所以古者道但盡妄緣即如如佛諸人還信得及麼若信得及止宿草庵

Override.AttributionNote: 古尊宿語錄, Yunfeng Wenyue section. Yunfeng Wenyue is the exact speaker: in the uninterrupted address he says that when attachment to saint and aversion to ordinary are exhausted, this is called true constancy fully exposed.
